svg.title: One attention block is three matrix multiplications, and one array cannot fill them all
svg.desc: Three columns, one per attention stage. Operand tokens flow left to right between stages. Under each stage an 8 by 8 array lights up where it can be used: all of it for the QKV projection, only half of the columns for the two per-head stages whose inner dimension is the head dimension.

text.tspan: With L = 256, H = 512 and nh = 8 heads the head dimension is D = H / nh = 64.
On an array wider than D, stages 2 and 3 leave processing elements idle.

svg.text: Source: common/workload_gen.py · workload_to_gemm_shapes (schematic; array fill illustrative, not measured)
